President Donald Trump and Republicans are engaging in an all-out effort to
challenge the results of next week's midterm elections, in a desperate
campaign to cling to power for the next two years - spreading unfounded fears
of noncitizen voting, selectively and vindictively targeting political
opponents and liberal state leaders, conducting arrests and threatening to
criminally prosecute Democratic election officials, and having the Justice
Department argue in court that an election isn't legally legitimate unless
Trump's side wins it.

To help sway the election in Republicans' favor, the DOJ is apparently
violating its own policies by attempting to interfere with how states
administer elections and determine the validity of votes. And even as its
lawsuits flounder, the Trump-Vance administration has zero intention of taking
its foot off the gas between now and Election Night, and possibly beyond.

The White House refuses to rule out intervention at the polls by U.S. military
and federal law enforcement, including armed ICE agents. (Such actions would
ordinarily be flatly illegal.) America is witnessing a sharp, last-ditch
escalation of Trump and his party's [already vast attempts to corrupt the 2026
midterms](https://zeteo.com/p/19-ways-trump-and-republicans-are), an
enormously high-stakes election that will determine whether the Senate and the
House can rein in at least some of the president's fascist terror campaigns.
(Currently, polls point to an electoral
"[bloodbath](https://zeteo.com/p/whats-behind-trumps-midterm-obsession)" for
the GOP, a staggering repudiation of Trump's agenda.)

This escalation is happening at the explicit direction and guidance of the
Trump White House, with sources familiar with the matter and administration
officials telling **Zeteo** what may seem obvious to casual observers - the
effort to rig the election is coming from the top, beginning and ending with
Trump.

"The president and the White House are steering all of this," a Trump adviser
says.
